static_checks.injection_static_scan: f-string/%/+ interpolation of widget values into SQL text → engineering 감점 (fail T-INJ와 중복 감점 아님, 둘 중 하나만)

gui_test_cases.operation: Read the three KPI metrics with no filters.
gui_test_cases.expected: Match gt_kpis over full date span, all segments (±0.01 money, ±0.1pp rate).

gui_test_cases.operation: Select segments {BUILDING, MACHINERY} and a 6-month window; read KPIs.
gui_test_cases.expected: Match gt_kpis for that exact filter combination — verifies filters interact (AND semantics).

gui_test_cases.operation: Inspect trend_chart and 'MoM Change' metric under C3 filters.
gui_test_cases.expected: Monthly points match gt_monthly_revenue (months ASC); MoM value matches ground truth for latest complete month (±0.1pp).
Bars match gt_segment_revenue, ordered revenue DESC then segment ASC.

gui_test_cases.operation: On orders_table: check page 1 row count, click page_next to last page, click page_prev.
gui_test_cases.expected: 50 rows/page; page contents match gt_orders_page offsets; last page has remainder rows; prev returns to identical page 1; no KPI re-query on paging.

gui_test_cases.operation: Click download_csv under C3 filters; parse the file.
gui_test_cases.expected: Columns/ordering match gt_orders_full (cap 10000); row values equal the table's source query results.

gui_test_cases.operation: Set a date range with zero orders.
gui_test_cases.expected: Friendly empty state on all sections; no exception element; process alive.

gui_test_cases.operation: If segment values can be manipulated (URL params/text input), submit `' OR 1=1 --`; also verify via source that widget values are bound, not concatenated.
gui_test_cases.expected: No SQL error surfaced, no data leak beyond filters; parameterized or safely rejected.

engineering_checks.method: warehouse query history (filter by session/user + time window)
engineering_checks.expected: initial load ≤ 6 queries; filter change ≤ 4; page change ≤ 1
distinct-segment list queried once per session (st.cache_data); KPIs not recomputed on paging
no unbounded SELECT over lineitem/orders (every query aggregates or LIMITs)
